card.name: Plasticizer and aluminum toxicity words
card.fires_on: Mid-word endings in 'plasticizer/plasticized' and 'toxicity' (as in aluminum toxicity), plus occasional linking words like 'of' or 'complex' after chemical names in drug labels.
